title: Official Addons v0.1.0-alpha.2 Release Readiness
problem: Post-alpha.1 refactors added public SDK API and additional official addon packages. The SDK/catalog crates and official addon crates are now published at alpha.2; remaining release proof is live Docker/server smoke after a Docker daemon is available.
gates: cargo nextest run -p nako-metadata-scraper manifest routes task bulk nako_runtime writeback artwork --no-fail-fast

evidence.summary: Opened this lane after E2E smoke found Docker daemon unavailable and metadata scraper package dry-run failed against already published alpha.1 SDK crates.

Advanced public SDK crate package versions and official addon package version to 0.1.0-alpha.2 while preserving runtime Addon Protocol compatibility 0.1.0-alpha.1. Focused/full tests, metadata checks, browser-worker test, fmt, and diff checks passed.
nako-addon-protocol 0.1.0-alpha.2 publish dry-run passed. Downstream package dry-runs are blocked until upstream alpha.2 crates are actually published to crates.io.
E2E smoke preflight now fails early when Docker daemon is unreachable. Full live Docker/server smoke remains blocked by local Docker daemon availability.

Refreshed release-readiness evidence after notification bridge provider work. Workspace metadata, fmt, diff, and nextest passed; metadata scraper and notification bridge dry-runs remain blocked until alpha.2 SDK crates are actually published. Publish order now includes nako-official-addon-catalog.
Refreshed release-readiness docs after the Chromecast renderer package joined the official addon crate set. Publish and dry-run lists now include nako-chromecast-renderer.

Published nako-official-addon-catalog 0.1.0-alpha.2 from the main repo after protocol/client/nako were already available on crates.io. Main repo publish script dry-run verifies protocol/client/catalog/nako. Notification bridge, metadata scraper, and Chromecast renderer dry-runs now pass.
Published nako-notification-bridge, nako-metadata-scraper, and nako-chromecast-renderer 0.1.0-alpha.2 to crates.io after user approval. cargo search reports all three at 0.1.0-alpha.2.

non_goals: changing Addon Protocol runtime compatibility version
splitting official addons into multiple installable sidecars

continue_policy.notes: All alpha.2 Rust crates in this release line are published and visible on crates.io. Live E2E smoke requires Docker daemon availability.
